admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Owner dashboard: today’s sales, staff, menu and restaurant settings.

captain.title: Captain
captain.description: Floor view and order pad for taking orders at the table.

kitchen.title: Kitchen display (KDS)
kitchen.description: Live KOTs by station: accept, start cooking and mark ready.

pos.title: Billing counter
pos.description: Open orders, bills, payments and cash shifts.

inventory.title: Stock
inventory.description: Raw material stock, recipes, wastage and stock counts.

purchase.title: Purchase
purchase.description: Vendors, purchase orders, goods received (GRN) and vendor payments.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Sales, GST, stock and profit reports, with export.

tokenDisplay.title: Token display
tokenDisplay.description: Ready-order token numbers for the customer TV.

qrMenu.title: QR menu
qrMenu.description: See the menu and order from your table. Table code: {token}

placeholder.body: This screen arrives in a later sprint. The layout, language and theme around it already work.

connection.queued: {count, plural, one {# action queued} other {# actions queued}}

hint.bluetooth: Wi-Fi is down. Orders are going over Bluetooth.
hint.offline: Cannot reach the Hub. Work is saved on this device and will be sent when the connection is back.

login.title: Sign in
login.chooseUser: Choose your name to sign in
login.pinEntered: {entered, plural, =0 {No digits entered} one {# digit entered} other {# digits entered}}

access.deniedBody: Your role cannot open {portal}. Ask a manager to give you access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not match any screen.

preview.title: Display check
preview.description: How table and KOT states, amounts and times will look on this screen.

errors.network: Cannot reach the Hub. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
errors.accountLocked: Too many wrong attempts. This account is locked until {time}.
errors.accountLockedNoTime: Too many wrong attempts. This account is locked for now. Ask a manager to unlock it.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is switched off. Ask a manager.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.versionConflict: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.validation: Some details are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.badResponse: The Hub sent an unexpected reply. Update the app or call support.
errors.invalidSetupCode: Wrong setup code. Check the code shown on the Hub’s screen.
errors.setupAlreadyDone: This Hub is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.liquorNotPermitted: Liquor sale is not allowed in this state. Turn liquor off, or confirm the override.
errors.stateNotAvailable: This state is not available on this installation yet.
errors.passwordTooWeak: This password is too easy to guess. Use a longer one, ideally a short sentence.
errors.pinTooWeak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid repeated digits (1111) and runs (1234, 4321).
errors.usernameTaken: This username is already used. Choose another.
errors.lastAdmin: This is the only Admin. Give someone else the Admin role first.
errors.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.permissionUnknown: One of the permissions is not known to the Hub. Reload and try again.
errors.taxGroupInvalid: This tax group is not valid. Check the rates and components.
errors.liquorNotEnabled: Liquor is not enabled for this branch.

boot.hubUnreachableBody: This device could not talk to the Hub PC. Check that the Hub is on and that this device is on the restaurant Wi-Fi.

validation.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
validation.passwordsDiffer: The two entries do not match.
validation.pinsDiffer: The two PINs do not match.
validation.username: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
validation.percent: Enter a percentage such as 5 or 2.5 (up to two decimals).
validation.amount: Enter an amount such as 50 or 49.50.
validation.pinWeak: Too easy to guess: avoid 1111, 1234 or 4321.

language.title: Language
language.body: Choose the language for setup. It also becomes the restaurant’s default; each person can change their own later.

business.title: Business and branch
business.orgNameHint: The name customers know, e.g. Spice Route.
business.branchCodeHint: 2 to 8 letters or digits, printed in bill numbers, e.g. KOL1.
business.gstinHint: Optional for now. 15 characters; the first two digits are the state code.

liquor.title: Liquor
liquor.body: Does this branch sell alcohol? Liquor is billed with state VAT, not GST.
liquor.enableHint: Adds the bar menu, liquor tax and the liquor bill.
liquor.prohibitedTitle: {state} is set up as a prohibition (dry) state
liquor.prohibitedBody: Liquor sale is normally not allowed here, so it stays off. Turn it on only if this branch holds a valid licence.
liquor.override: This branch holds a valid liquor licence: allow liquor anyway
liquor.advisor: Liquor VAT and surcharge differ by state and change often. There is no default: confirm both rates with your tax advisor before entering them.
liquor.separateHint: Food (GST) and liquor (VAT) on two bills with their own numbers. Many states require this.

receipt.title: Receipt languages
receipt.body: Choose one or two languages to print on bills. Two makes a bilingual bill.

admin.title: Owner account
admin.body: This account can do everything, including adding staff. Keep the password safe.
admin.pinHint: Optional. 4 to 6 digits for fast sign-in on shared devices.

backup.title: Backup passphrase
backup.body: Backups are encrypted with this passphrase. You need it to restore your data on a new PC.
backup.warningBody: Nobody, not even RestroOS support, can reset this passphrase. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe, away from the restaurant PC.
backup.passphraseHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
backup.acknowledge: I have written the passphrase down and kept it safe

review.title: Review and finish
review.setupCodeHint: Shown on the Hub PC’s screen when it started for the first time. It proves you are at the restaurant.

errors.gstinFormat: Not a valid GSTIN: 15 characters such as 19AABCU9603R1ZX.
errors.gstinState: This GSTIN belongs to another state. Its first two digits must match the state code.
errors.gstinChecksum: The last character does not match. Check the GSTIN for typing mistakes.
errors.prohibition: Liquor is not allowed in this state unless you confirm the licence override.
errors.vatRate: VAT must be more than 0% and at most 100%.
errors.passphrasesDiffer: The two passphrases do not match.
errors.acknowledge: Please confirm you have written it down.
errors.setupCode: Enter the code shown on the Hub (6 to 32 characters).

states.26: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

users.title: Staff
users.description: Who can sign in, what they can do, and their PINs.
users.name: Name
users.languageHint: The app switches to it when this person signs in.

done.deactivate: Account deactivated. This person can no longer sign in.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: A role is a set of permissions. Give each person one or more roles.
roles.userCount: {count, plural, =0 {No staff} one {# person} other {# people}}
roles.editorDescription: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions selected.} one {# permission selected.} other {# permissions selected.}}
roles.adminLocked: The Admin role always has every permission and cannot be changed, so the owner can never be locked out.
roles.name: Role name
roles.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and _, e.g. HEAD_CHEF.
roles.codeError: Start with a capital letter; 2 to 32 capital letters, digits or _.

settings.manage: Change restaurant, tax and printer settings

tables.update_status: Mark tables free, reserved or cleaning

orders.update: Change items before sending to kitchen

kds.update_status: Accept, cook and mark KOTs ready

billing.discount: Give discounts within the role limit

branch.title: Branch settings
branch.description: Details printed on bills, registrations, and how bills are rounded.
branch.stateFixed: The state and branch code cannot be changed after setup.
branch.roundingHint: The difference shows on the bill as “Round off”.
branch.dayStartHint: Sales after midnight but before this time count for the previous day.
branch.defaultLanguageHint: For devices and staff that have not chosen one.
branch.receiptHeaderHint: Printed at the top of every bill, e.g. FSSAI licence number.
branch.receiptFooterHint: Printed at the bottom, e.g. “Thank you! Visit again.”

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: Tax groups are attached to menu items. GST for food; state VAT for liquor.
taxes.name: Name
taxes.nameHint: As staff will see it, e.g. GST 5% (restaurant).
taxes.seriesHint: Which bill numbers items with this tax go on.
taxes.inclusiveHint: Menu prices already contain this tax; the bill shows it inside the price.
taxes.gstRateHint: Total GST, e.g. 5. CGST and SGST are half each; IGST is the full rate.
taxes.gstPreview: Within the state: CGST {half}% + SGST {half}%. Other states: IGST {full}%.

errors.gstOdd: This rate cannot be split equally into CGST and SGST. Use the advanced editor.
errors.components: Add 1 to 6 components, each with a rate up to 100%.

charges.title: Service and other charges
charges.description: Charges added to bills, such as a service charge or packing charge.
charges.name: Name
charges.nameHint: Printed on the bill, e.g. Service charge.
charges.taxGroupHint: Service charge usually carries the same GST as food.
charges.optionalHint: The cashier can remove it from a bill. Service charge must be optional.

printers.title: Printers
printers.description: Bill and KOT printers. Printing itself arrives in a later update.
printers.name: Name
printers.nameHint: Where it is, e.g. Counter bill printer.
printers.addressHint: IP address and port for network printers (e.g. 192.168.1.50:9100), or the device name.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change and sensitive action, who did it and who approved it. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.verifyOkBody: {rows, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} checked at {time}. None has been altered or removed.
audit.verifyBroken: The audit log has been tampered with
audit.verifyBrokenBody: The chain breaks at entry {id}. Entries from here on may have been altered or deleted. Back up the database now and contact support.
